summary: Iteration 13 testing completed. All requested features verified: 1) Saathi chatbot gives SHORT 1-2 line responses and asks questions, 2) Saathi uses simple words (no 'areas', 'aspects', 'domains'), 3) Sonali has ONLY 45 min option at ₹1299 (FIXED - was showing 60 min before), 4) Anushka has ONLY 45 min option at ₹1199, 5) Prakhar has both 45 min (₹999) and 60 min (₹1249), 6) Blog page has 50 articles from March/April 2025, 7) Blog search and category filtering works, 8) Animation classes working, 9) Community page sign-in works, 10) Booking form has Emergency Contact Number field, 11) Form button says 'Submit Request'.

saathi_chatbot_short_responses.details: Saathi responds with SHORT 1-2 line responses. Examples: 'What do you think is making you feel this way?', 'What part of work or life feels the most stressful for you right now?', 'That sounds really challenging. What specific thoughts or feelings are making you anxious about your future?'

saathi_simple_words.details: Chatbot uses simple words - no 'areas', 'aspects', 'domains' found in responses. System prompt explicitly forbids these words.

sonali_only_45_min.details: FIXED: Sonali's booking modal now shows ONLY 45 min option at ₹1299. Fixed getSessionPricing() function to only include 60 min if price60 is not null.

anushka_only_45_min.details: Anushka has ONLY 45 min option at ₹1199 (price60: null in mockData.js)

prakhar_both_options.details: Prakhar has both 45 min (₹999) and 60 min (₹1249) options

blog_50_articles.details: Blog page shows 'All Updates (50)' with articles dated March/April 2025. Load More shows '38 remaining' (12 visible + 38 = 50 total)

blog_search_filtering.details: Search for 'depression' returns 10 articles. Category filtering works: Research & Studies (18), Policy & Budget (10), Healthcare News (12), Workplace Wellness (5), Self-Care (3), Trends (2)

animation_classes.details: Animation classes present: animate-fade-in, animate-fade-in-up, animate-marquee, hover-lift, etc. in index.css

community_signin.details: Community page has Sign In / Sign Up functionality with email/password form

emergency_contact_field.details: Booking form has 'Emergency Contact Number *' field with helper text 'Someone we can reach in case of emergency'

submit_request_button.details: 'Submit Request' button present in booking form (not 'Proceed to Payment')

cta_fix_time.details: CTA 'We can help you fix a time that works for you' present in Blog page and chatbot system prompt
